why: B delivers what the client called the main piece: a tall, wide, dark-wood bookcase that matches the floor and holds many books. A's ladder bookcase is only 66 cm wide and shallow, so it cannot take up much of the wall or hold many books. B's dark wood, round side table and jute rug also make a more coherent, warm reading nook. Both proposals share the same armchair and rug, so the bookcase and the supporting pieces decide it.
